new_value: Kconfig 89478d9303: LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST now 'depends on LICHEN_OSCORE' (sibling pattern of CLIENT_OSCORE/SERVER_OSCORE/WAYPOINTS/DEADDROP/HANDOFF); LICHEN_CHECKIN_RESOURCE now 'depends on LICHEN_COAP_SERVER' plus help documenting the STANDALONE-or-app-service requirement (resources are COAP_RESOURCE_DEFINE(..., lichen_coap_server, ...); service must be subsystem coap_server.c with its iterable section, or an app-owned service declaring the coap_resource_lichen_coap_server section). Smoke-configure proof (west build --cmake-only qemu_x86/atom, ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES, EXTRA_CONF_FILE fragments, .config inspected): combo A OSCORE=y -> CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST=y; combo B OSCORE=n -> kconfig warning 'LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST ... got the value n', symbol off; combo C STANDALONE=y -> CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_RESOURCE=y; combo D COAP_SERVER=n -> CHECKIN_RESOURCE not enabled. No committed prj.conf sets LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST=y directly (rangetest suite uses compile-definition), so no config regressions.
